propositions: The LLM step failure tally must be extended from review-plan scope to both review-code and verify-completion gates via collect_step_failures() activation and drain wiring.
The review-code gate drains survived LLM step failures into coverage.llm_step_failures on the code-review verdict, present only when non-empty.

The verify-completion gate drains survived LLM step failures into coverage.llm_step_failures on the completion verdict, with the entire coverage object created only when the tally is non-empty to preserve byte-identity on clean signed verdicts.
Both code_review_verdict.schema.json and completion_verdict.schema.json must declare coverage.llm_step_failures with required fields [total, by_step], mirroring plan_review_verdict.schema.json.
Observability-only change: no verdict content, exit code, signature, or behavior changes; clean runs remain unaffected and unsigned verdicts unchanged.
Run scopes at gate_dispatch.py:480 (review-code) and gate_dispatch.py:696 (verify-completion) must activate the sink so failures are recorded.
